The '''mouth-operated gun''' was a ranged weapon intended for operation by the [[Laboi]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Limb/Legends|limbless]] [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Laboi II]]. The mouth-operated weapon required no hands to fire and was useful to Laboi who left their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] for the [[The galaxy/Legends|greater galaxy]]. Nevertheless, such technology was incredibly rare and extremely expensive; during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it cost at least ten times the price of a comparable hand-operated weapon.<ref name="GG4b" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|second edition of ''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'']] mentions the mouth-operated gun as a possible piece of equipment for Laboi characters in [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The book, updated by [[Chuck Truett]] from the [[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|original edition]] by [[Troy Denning]], marks the first mention of such technology. The source fails to specify whether such weapons used [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] technology, [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] technology, or something else.<ref name="GG4b" />
